name: chrome-bridge-mcp
description: MCP server that drives your already-running, already-logged-in Chrome via a companion extension using chrome.debugger/CDP. Clean-room equivalent of the Codex/ChatGPT desktop Chrome tool.

scripts.test: node test/security.mjs && node test/smoke.mjs && node test/multi-client.mjs
scripts.test:all: npm run test && npm run test:e2e
scripts.test:unit: node --test --experimental-test-coverage --test-coverage-include=dist/cdp-allowlist.js --test-coverage-include=dist/hub.js --test-coverage-include=dist/pagescript.js --test-coverage-include=dist/setup.js --test-coverage-include=dist/tools.js --test-coverage-lines=100 --test-coverage-branches=90 --test-coverage-functions=88 test/cdp-allowlist.test.mjs test/hub.test.mjs test/pagescript.test.mjs test/setup.test.mjs test/tools.test.mjs
